result.title: $D^2$-OPD: Separating Direction and Distance in Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Extrapolative OPD further extends the teacher's log-probability shift relative to a reference policy to construct stronger learning targets. However, existing methods couple extrapolation direction and distance, allowing the magnitude of the teacher's shift to dictate how far the target moves. We propose $D^2$-OPD, decoupling these two factors: a per-prefix hard KL constraint bounds the target's distance from the teacher, while an adaptive combination of the teacher's post-training shift and the initial student--teacher gap determines the extrapolation direction. We optimize the student toward this target using forward KL, providing learning signals even for low-probability tokens. We evaluate three settings: where standard OPD performs well, where it struggles with base-model initialization, and where no teacher reference is available. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, $D^2$-OPD attains the highest score in all three settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.45 points. Ablations validate the contributions of each component.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 D²-OPD，把 on-policy 蒸馏中的外推方向与外推距离解耦：用 per-prefix 的 hard KL 约束限制目标偏离教师的幅度，方向则由教师训练后偏移与初始师生差距的自适应组合决定，并以 forward KL 优化学生。
AI.relevance_reason: 属纯文本蒸馏的目标构造，不涉及视觉或 latent 状态；但「约束目标-教师距离、仅外推方向」的思路可能可供核查于 latent 轨迹蒸馏，用于控制状态漂移、避免学生过度偏离教师表示。
